checks.test: Validated public recipient saves and upserts by fingerprint while preserving creation time
Alias bounds count Unicode code points and reject empty, oversized or control-containing names
Forged fingerprints, private-key fields and invalid identifiers are rejected
Concurrent writes enforce the 50-contact cap and still allow existing-contact updates
IndexedDB contains only names, timestamps and validated public bundles
Contact removal and replacement leave the private identity database unchanged
